decisions.reason: Its strong fit with integrated airport operations and earlier visible commitment mean management would likely keep it, as results are likely near aspiration and the firm still has slack to learn from adoption.

Because billing software is less central to the firm's operational-control identity and has now had time to prove itself, management would keep it for now but with a higher withdrawal risk if results remain below aspiration relative to more core software offers.
This monitoring product reinforces the firm's installed-base service model and data-driven strategy, so complementarities make it likely to stay unless performance clearly falls short of aspiration.

A controller safety alert service sits close to the firm's safety-critical value proposition, making continued retention likely as long as it remains at least near aspiration for customers and internal benchmarks.
